dialogues.speaker: Housewife Raven
dialogues.text: You're back so late today. I'm so hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Off-Work Raven
dialogues.text: I saw a stage on the island on my commute home, and I stood there awhile.

dialogues.speaker: Off-Work Raven
dialogues.text: Ok, got it. You go take a rest, I'll finish preparing the meal...
